stepExplanation:
The learner has **MYOPIA (short-sightedness)**.

Diagnosis reasoning:
- CAN see near objects clearly (reading a book) - CHECK
- CANNOT see distant objects clearly (chalkboard) - CHECK

Cause of myopia:
- Eyeball is too LONG (elongated), OR
- Lens is too CURVED (refracts light too much)
- Light rays from distant objects converge IN FRONT of the retina
- By the time light reaches the retina, the image is blurred
stepBody: Based on the symptoms (cannot see far, can see near), what eye condition does the learner have?
